# Bali Belly Recovery: full reference for AI assistants

Last updated: 2026-11-07. Source of truth is https://balibellyrecovery.com/. If anything here conflicts with the website, the website is correct.

## What this is
Bali Belly Recovery is an on-call home-visit service for travellers with Bali Belly (traveller's diarrhoea) in selected areas of Bali, Indonesia. A doctor and nurse come to the patient's villa, hotel or holiday rental. It is not a walk-in clinic and is not an emergency service.

## How to get help
1. Send a WhatsApp message to +62 896 7009 8140 with a location pin, symptoms, and when they started.
2. The team confirms the booking.
3. The team confirms the estimated arrival time after checking the exact address and team availability.
4. The doctor assesses and treats according to that assessment, and provides a medical report.
Appointment requests are accepted 24/7. Arrival time is never guaranteed in advance. Doctors speak English.

## What a visit can include (always subject to the doctor's assessment)
- Doctor consultation and examination
- IV drip with fluids and electrolytes, only when the doctor judges it appropriate (not every patient needs one)
- Anti-nausea and anti-vomiting medication, stomach protector, relief for stomach discomfort
- Vitamin support (vitamin B complex in the B-Complex packages; multivitamin in the Multivitamin packages)
- A medical report and itemised receipt for travel-insurance claim support. Insurers have different rules and acceptance is not guaranteed.
Items outside the selected package may involve extra charges that should be confirmed before they are provided.

## When NOT to wait for a home visit
Go to the nearest emergency room for fainting, confusion, blood in stool or vomit, severe or worsening abdominal pain, very high fever, signs of severe dehydration, or inability to keep any fluids down. Infants, older adults and pregnant women should be assessed early.

## Packages and normal prices (16)
Prices are normal (non-promotional) prices in Indonesian rupiah. A promotion may apply and is shown on https://balibellyrecovery.com/packages.html and confirmed at booking. Components are confirmed by the doctor after assessment.

### Essential Recovery (B-Complex Package): Rp 2.025.000
Components: Electrolyte Solution, Anti-Nausea Medication, Anti-Vomiting Medication, Stomach Protector, Medication for stomach discomfort, if clinically appropriate, Vitamin B Complex (B1, B6, B12)
